text_block_list.text: The eve of the fateful Japan Derby—

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Dura?
Sorry to call so late."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't mind, but...
This is about tomorrow's race, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me hear it.
Whether it's encouragement or advice.

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
"‘No, knowing you, you're probably fully prepared.
So it's not really a big deal, but...’"

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Please, don't push yourself too hard.
Just make it across the finish line safely."

text_block_list.name: Dura's Father
text_block_list.text: "You are the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I will engrave it into my heart—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...And that was the phone call
I got from my father last night.
choice_data_list: I see, gotta give it our all then!
I see, we'll have to do our best then!

text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Derby,
as I was heading to the racetrack with Duramente—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh,
found ya!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Duramente!
I've been waiting for you.

She is Jungle Pocket...
A mischievous, but undisputed champion who once
conquered the Japanese Derby.
choice_data_list: What do you mean you were waiting?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see it!
—The one they call the "strongest of our era."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm running with my eyes on the very top—
to be the strongest, after all. Course I'm curious, right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
In the current Classic generation,
the one they say is the strongest... is you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're aware you're carrying that weight, right?
Don't try tellin' me you aren't.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you say, Duramente?
Are you... the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket.
I don't understand the meaning of your question. But――"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Today,
we will see that answer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
âIf you want to know,
just keep your eyes open.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
…………Ahahaha!
Hahaha! I love it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You've got some serious guts!
Yeah, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
This year's Derby looks pretty exciting too.
My money's on you, Duramente!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Show me your absolute best.
...I'm counting on you.
(*Tap*)

Jungle Pocket lightly tapped her fist
against Duramente's chest and walked away in high spirits.
choice_data_list: I wonder what that was all about...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I don't understand.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: For some reason... it feels warm.
(Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"W-Woah, incredible...!
So this is the 'Nippon Derby'!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Everyone's waiting to see what kind of results "the" Duramente will put up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That run in the Satsuki Sho was insane!
You're my absolute, number-one, top favorite!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Dura.
Good luck out there."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *phew*...

After changing into her racewear, Duramente
calmed herself. Starting from this race, she had adopted
a new method of mental control.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Con anima"... Pray.
So that it connects...
(Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I hear it. Everything... so vividly.
The wind, the breath of the Umamusume, the excitement of the crowd...)

"Duramente!
We're counting on you!"

"For the pride of our clan!
Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(――...It's strange.
I can take in... every bit of it.)

Duramente's eyes were crystal clear.
The wild roughness had calmed, replaced by an aura of true power.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...I'm off.

Unable to contain myself, I called out to her.
Watching her now makes my heart burn with passion.
If it's Duramente—she can make it come true.
choice_data_list: I want to take on the world with you.
I want to go to the world stage with you.

text_block_list.text: —The unconquered summit for Japanese Umamusume. A crown that so many racing personnel and Umamusume... have yearned for and sought after...!
—I want to see the view from that summit, stood upon by a Japanese Derby Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm getting nervous.
Hey, Kura-chan—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...What's wrong?
Don't tell me you're nervous too, Cla-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Nervous? Not at all!
I've thoroughly devised the perfect strategy for today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's not it... Just look at Duramente's eyes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—A brilliance unlike before.
Something inside her had changed.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Somehow... you seem really calm.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They might be even tougher
than anyone we've faced before.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Even more than before...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We might need to rethink
our strategy a little.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~ What should
I do—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There is only one answer. Keep thinking until the race starts... No,
keep thinking even after it begins.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby...
—I'm the one who's going to win it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "I have to give it my all too...!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Let's go.
